inlines.v: PREPAR'ATORY, adjective 1. Previously necessary; useful or qualifying; preparing the way for any thing by previous measures of adaptation. The practice of virtue and piety is preparatory to the happiness of heaven. 2. Introductory; previous; antecedent and adapted to what follows.
